skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Explain basic concepts and knowledge about network management systems, procedures, and security mechanisms of Simple Network Management Protocol (SNMP).
Explain the functions of basic network devices and perform configuration tasks using simulation tools.

Perform user organization and management on Windows Server environment, set up and deploy group policies, manage shared network resources such as directories, files, DNS, DHCP, Web server, File server, Mail server, etc.
Describe firewall structure, basic functions, classification, advantages, and disadvantages, and explain firewall knowledge in network management and security.
Proficiently use tools to configure network devices optimally in various network models.
Proficiently find, collect, synthesize, analyze, and present solutions to problems related to network management.
Collaborate with team members to solve group assignments, ensuring timely completion of group work.
Answer questions posed by instructors, complete in-class and homework assignments.
Participate in group discussions to solve problems, defend personal opinions before the group.
Complete instructor-assigned projects, collaborate with group members to finish assigned tasks.
